{{short description|American mathematician}}
'''Boris Mordukhovich''' ({{langx|ru|Борис Шолимович Мордухович}}) is an American [[mathematician]] recognized for his research in the areas of [[Nonlinear functional analysis|nonlinear analysis]], [[Optimization (mathematics)|optimization]], and [[control theory]]. Mordukhovich is one of the founders of modern [[variational analysis]] and generalized differentiation.  Currently he is Distinguished University Professor and Lifetime Scholar of the Academy of Scholars at [[Wayne State University]] (Vice President, 2009–2010 and President, 2010–2011).

==Life and works==
Mordukhovich was born and educated in the [[Soviet Union]]; he emigrated to the United States with his family in December 1988. He developed constructions of generalized differentiation (bearing now his name), and their development and applications to classes of problems in variational analysis, optimization, equilibrium, control, economics, engineering, and other fields.<ref>{{cite journal|last1=Henrion |first1=R. |last2=Kruger |first2=A. |last3=Outrata |first3=J. |year=2008 |title=Boris Mordukhovich, The Never Tired Traveller, Celebrates His Sixtieth Birthday |journal=Set-Valued Analysis |volume=16 |issue= 2–3|pages=125–127 |doi=10.1007/s11228-008-0069-9 |hdl=1959.17/66904 |s2cid=120131405 }}</ref><ref>{{cite journal|last1=Torres |first1=D. F. M. |last2=Zaslavski |first2=A. J. |year=2009 |title=Editorial to the special issue of the International Journal of Mathematics and Statistics (IJMS), dedicated to Boris S. Mordukhovich on the occasion of his 60th birthday |journal=International Journal of Mathematics and Statistics|volume=5 |page=A09 }}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=Vietnam Journal of Mathematics {{!}} Volume 42, issue 4 |url=https://link.springer.com/journal/10013/42/4?wt_mc=alerts.TOCjournals |access-date=2023-10-13 |website=SpringerLink |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=Journal of Optimization Theory and Applications {{!}} Volume 206, article number 36 |url=https://link.springer.com/article/10.1007/s10957-025-02696-3 |access-date=2025-05-27 |website=SpringerLink |language=en}}</ref> His theory and various applications have been summarized in the 2-volume monograph,<ref>B. S. Mordukhovich, "''Variational Analysis and Generalized Differentiation, '''I''': Basic Theory, '''II''': Applications''," Grundlehren Series (Fundamental Principles of Mathematical Sciences), Vols. 330 and 331, Springer, 2006.</ref> and in his more recent books,<ref>B. S. Mordukhovich, "''Variational Analysys and Applications''," Springer Monographs in Mathematics, 2018</ref><ref>B. S. Mordukhovich and N. M. Nam, "''Convex Analysis and Beyond''," Springer Series in Operations Research and Financial Engineering, 2022</ref> and.<ref>B. S. Mordukhovich, "''Second-Order Variational Analysis in Optimization, Variational Stability, and Control''," Springer Series in Operations Research and Financial Engineering, 2024</ref> Mordukhovich has published more than 550 journal papers.

Mordukhovich is an AMS Fellow of the Inaugural Class,<ref>{{Cite web | url=https://www.ams.org/profession/ams-fellows/ams-fellows | title=American Mathematical Society}}</ref><ref>[https://www.ams.org/profession/fellows-list List of Fellows of the American Mathematical Society], retrieved 2013-02-10.</ref> a SIAM Fellow,<ref>{{Cite web | url=http://fellows.siam.org/index.php?sort=year&value=2011 | title=Fellows Program &#124; SIAM}}</ref> and a recipient of many international awards and honors, including [[2025 INFORMS Frederick W. Lanchester Prize]],<ref>{{Cite web | url=https://meetings.informs.org/wordpress/annual/awards-hall/| title=INFORMS President’s Award| date=2025-10-26}}</ref>  [[Dr. Honoris Causa]] from the [[National Sun Yat-sen University]] in [[Taiwan]], [[University of Messina]],<ref>{{Cite web | url=http://www.tempostretto.it/news/riconoscimenti-accademici-laurea-magistrale-honoris-causa-matematica-boris-mordukhovich.html | title=Laurea magistrale honoris causa in Matematica a Boris title=La Primatóloga Inglesa Jane Goodall Será Investida Doctora Honoris Causa Por la Universidad de Alicante}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.ua.es/dossierprensa/2009/01/29/11.html |title=El Editor (2008) and was a co-Editor-in-Chief (2009–2014) of ''[https://www.springer.com/math/analysis/journal/11228 Set-Valued and Variational Analysis],'' an international journal. Since 2016, he is a co-Editor-in-Chief, Applied Analysis and Optimization, and since 2021 he is the area editor of Journal of Optimization Theory and Application. He was Chair (2012 - 2015) of the International Working Group on Generalized Convexity and Monotonicity.<ref>{{Cite web | url=http://www.genconv.org/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=86:10th-international-symposium-on-generalized-convexity-and-generalized-monotonicity&catid=1:latest-news | title=Working Group on Generalized Convexity}}</ref> In 2016, he was elected to the Accademia Peloritana dei Pericolanti (Italy), and in 2021 he became a Foreign Member of the National Academy of Sciences of Ukraine.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.nas.gov.ua/UA/Messages/Pages/View.aspx?MessageID=7843 |date=27 May 2021 |title=New members have been elected to the National Academy of Sciences of Ukraine |website=[[National Academy of Sciences of Ukraine]]}}</ref> He is on the list of Highly Cited Researchers in Mathematics <ref>{{Cite web | url=http://community.thomsonreuters.com/t5/InCites-Customer-Forum/Preliminary-publication-of-new-lists-of-Highly-Cited-Researchers/td-p/36685 | title=Preliminary publication of new lists of Highly Cited Researchers| date=2012-12-31}}</ref> and Inaugural ScholarGPS Highly Ranked Scholar in Mathematical Optimization, 2024.<ref>{{Cite web | url=
https://scholargps.com/scholars/64575695940293/boris-s-mordukhovich?tracking_id=8b6a1ae56b5542ba45dd | title=ScholarGps| date=2024}}</ref>
